jobs.company: Lundquist Institute For Biomedical Innovation At Harbor-ucla
jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Temporary)
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center is an independent, non-profit biomedical research organization located in Torrance, California. In dozens of laboratories throughout the campus, researchers are working to unravel the mysteries of heart and kidney disease, cardiac complications in newborns, chronic lung disease, skin cancer, sickle cell disease, disorders of the autoimmune system, and much more. Many of these projects are collaborative in nature, involving experts from different areas of specialization. Our discoveries have prevented blindness in newborns, enabled premature infants with fragile lungs to breathe and allowed children with rare, often fatal diseases to grow up healthy and strong.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in administration and/or office management in an academic healthcare setting. Desired experience with ACGME and other accrediting and regulatory bodies that affect resident and fellow education.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with absolute confidentiality.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Excellent organization skills with an ability to multitask and prioritize competing priorities.
* Must be comfortable working independently and in a collaborative team environment consisting of diverse
* populations of staff, faculty, resident/fellows and other administrative personnel.
* Must be able to adapt quickly to changes in work requirements and assignments in a proactive manner
* Strong critical and analytical thinking skills.

**Responsibilities:**

With oversight from the Program Director and Department Administrator, Medical Education, the Program Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administration of the ACGME residency/fellowship program(s). The Program Coordinator (PC) assists the Graduate Medical Education (GME) office and Program Director (PD) in developing and maintaining the educational quality of the training program and ensuring compliance with ACGME accreditation standards and Institutional requirements. The PC functions as a liaison between the GME office, PD, residents/fellows, medical students, participating sites, and other departments. The PC will continually assess a wide range of programmatic issues including maintaining databases, communicating with faculty and trainees regarding a range of issues, and collaborating with the GME office to plan annual events including recruitment, orientation, graduation, faculty development events, and various program-related events.

Program Accreditation and Compliance

* Develop understanding of ACGME policies and procedures, including familiarity with the Common
* Program Requirements, Specialty-Specific requirements, and Institutional Requirements.
* Maintain all essential documents required for program accreditation and ensuring program faculty possess the appropriate credential indicated by the program’s Review Committee. This includes confirming that
* CVs containing a current list of publications and scholarly activity are logged in ACGME WebADS system as required by ACGME.
* Assist the PD in maintaining the program’s ACGME WebADS system; keep a working copy and make changes on an ongoing basis.
* Manage and coordinate ACGME site visits, including preparation of the site visit documentation. Along with the PD, help prepare program, faculty, and residents/fellows for site visit; arrangement meeting rooms;ensure required documents are available to the site visitor as requested; and serve as key participate in the site visit.
* Prepare Program Letters of Agreement (in coordination with GME office leadership) with participating institutions and training sites. Ensure agreements are revised as needed.
* Under the direction of the PD, preparing the documentation for the Annual Program Evaluation for submission to the Institutional Sponsor as part of the annual Institutional required, as required by ACGME.
* Administer New Innovations Residency Management System for the program(s), including maintaining resident/fellow demographic data; resident/fellow schedules, importing program and rotation goals and objectives; conferences attendance tracking; and ensuring timely completion of duty hour reports.
* Ensure residents/fellows submit case/procedure log data in appropriate systems as required by ACGME Review Committee.
* Distribution of required documents to faculty and resident, including rotation goals and objectives, program manuals, program policies, etc.
* Establish and ensure compliance with program-specific credentialing requirements (e.g., ACLS, PALS, ATLS, etc.)
* Ensure resident/fellow compliance with Institutional credentialing and HR requirements, including medical licensees, DEA licenses, employee health, mandatory education training, and other training as required.
* Complete surveys and ensure information is current in various GME systems.
* Coordinate and staff various committees, including residency management meetings, faculty curriculum. committee meetings, departmental meetings, meetings with PD, and with the resident/fellows, and follow up on action items as required.
* Manage administrative and planning for logistics for meetings and conferences, including monthly lecture series, conferences, grand rounds, journal club, M&M, ACLS courses, and in-service exams
* Compile and submit required data elements to the Specialty Boards and other professional organizations as required.
* Administration of Resident/Fellow Activities In consultation with the PD, develop and maintain resident/fellows schedules, including rotation schedules, call schedules, and clinic schedules; maintain current schedules into New Innovations and update as needed.
* Coordinate information and schedules with other services, sites, and departments, including rotation/call schedules, and evaluations.
* In collaboration with GME office

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, versatile, and customer-focused professional to join our team in a hybrid role that combines in-store sales and customer service with essential office and administrative responsibilities.

The ideal candidate will be a motivated and results-oriented sales professional with strong organizational and administrative skills. This individual should be comfortable working directly with customers on the sales floor while efficiently managing office responsibilities and supporting day-to-day store operations.

The successful candidate will be able to seamlessly transition between customer service, sales, and administrative tasks, while maintaining a professional demeanor, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to providing excellent service.

* Administrative Support: Assist store management with preparing reports, maintaining records, and completing other administrative duties as needed.

Qualifications

* Retail Sales Experience: 3–4 years of proven retail sales experience, preferably in the beauty industry.
* Bilingual: Fluent in both English and Spanish.
* Customer Service: Friendly, approachable, and professional demeanor with a strong customer-first attitude.
* Professional Appearance: Well-groomed and maintains a professional appearance.
* Administrative Experience: Previous experience in an administrative or office support role.
* Technical Skills: Proficient in POS systems and Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, and Excel
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and team members.
* Organization and Time Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and balance retail sales and administrative responsibilities.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

jobs.title: Inbound Licensing Coordinator
jobs.description:
CA EMPLOYEE PRIVACY RIGHTS: https://www.mgae.com/ca-employee-privacy-rights

**MGA Entertainment** is on a mission to inspire imagination and creativity through innovative toys, entertainment, and experiences that transform play into limitless possibilities. As the largest privately held toy and entertainment company in the U.S., MGA is a global leader in designing and delivering world-class consumer products that spark wonder and drive play forward. Headquartered in Los Angeles with offices worldwide, MGA’s portfolio spans a dynamic range of original and licensed brands — from toys, dolls, games, and electronics to fashion, home décor, and entertainment content including hit movies and TV series. The company is recognized for its bold approach to storytelling, trendsetting design, and deep commitment to quality. The award-winning MGA family includes fan-favorite brands such as L.O.L. Surprise!™, Little Tikes®, Rainbow High™, Bratz®, MGA’s Miniverse™, Yummiland™, CarTuned™, Wonder Factory™, BABY born®, and Zapf Creation®. To learn more, visit www.mgae.com and follow MGA on LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.

**Position Overview**

MGA Entertainment is seeking an organized, proactive Inbound Licensing Coordinator to manage the submission and approval process for licensed items across the business. Sitting within the Inbound Licensing team, this role will serve as a central point of coordination between Sales, Brand Marketing, Creative, external licensing partners and other key stakeholders. Working collaboratively with the Senior Director of Creative, Inbound Licensing, the Inbound Licensing Coordinator will ensure submissions are complete, feedback is communicated clearly and approvals progress efficiently to support product launches, marketing campaigns and commercial deadlines.

This role requires an understanding of both licensing and marketing, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholder relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the submission, tracking and approval of licensed products, packaging, marketing materials, sales assets, digital content and other items requiring licensor approval.
* Liaise with Sales, Brand Marketing, Creative and other internal stakeholders together assets, confirm requirements and establish submission timelines.
* Prepare and submit approval requests through licensor portals and other agreed channels, ensuring each submission is accurate, complete and aligned with relevant guidelines.
* Work closely with the Senior Director of Creative, Inbound Licensing, to coordinate creative reviews, clarify feedback and support revisions.
* Act as the day-to-day contact for approval-related communication between internal teams and licensing partners.
* Traffic licensor feedback to the appropriate stakeholders, clarify required changes and follow up on revisions and resubmissions through to final approval.
* Maintain a central approvals tracker, providing clear visibility of submission status, outstanding actions, deadlines and potential delays.
* Proactively identify and escalate approval issues or conflicting feedback that could affect launch dates, production schedules or campaign delivery.
* Maintain accurate records of submissions, feedback, approved assets and final sign-offs, with clear version control.
* Communicate approval status and usage conditions so teams have the necessary sign-offs before production, publication or distribution.
* Help improve submission processes, briefing templates and communication practices to reduce rework and support timely approvals.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* A sound understanding of licensing and marketing, including licensor approval processes, brand guidelines and the development of marketing assets.
* Previous experience in marketing coordination, licensing, creative operations, project coordination or a similar role.
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple submissions, competing priorities and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* High attention to detail when reviewing assets, consolidating feedback and maintaining approval records.
* A proactive, collaborative approach, with the confidence to follow up on outstanding actions and escalate issues appropriately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project tracking tools; experience with licensor approval platforms is advantageous.
* Experience in toys, entertainment, consumer products or licensed brands is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

Complete and accurate submissions, clear stakeholder communication, current approval records and timely sign-offs that support MGA’s product launches and marketing activity.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Hematology/Oncology (Santa Monica)
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Clinical Research Coordinator supports the operational management of clinical research activities throughout the study lifecycle, including design, start-up, conduct, and closeout. This role is responsible for implementing and managing research activities for one or more studies, prioritizing tasks to meet required deadlines. The Coordinator plans and organizes study activities to ensure compliance with study protocols and applicable regulations, including institutional policies, FDA Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), and ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP). The role involves close collaboration with the Principal Investigator, ancillary departments, central research teams, sponsors, and external institutions to support compliant study conduct, financial management, and adequate staffing.

Hourly salary range: $38.19 - $61.45

  
Pay range: $38.19 - $61.45 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimally 2+ years of previous study coordination or clinical research coordination experience
* Interpersonal skills to effectively communicate information in a timely, professional manner and establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with students, staff, faculty, external collaborators and administration and to work as a member of a team.
* Ability to effectively communicate to and interact with patients in a compassionate and kind manner.
* Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, to meet the programmatic and department needs, while complying with applicable University policies and federal and state regulations.
* Analytical skills to assess clinical research protocols and regulatory requirements, define problems, formulate logical solutions, develop alternative solutions, make recommendations, and initiate corrective actions.
* Close attention to detail to ensure accuracy in a fast-paced, fluctuating workload environment.
* Organization skills to create and maintain administrative and regulatory files effectively as well as independently balance the various tasks to ensure deadlines are met.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe and Microsoft suite software, especially Excel, to perform daily tasks efficiently and accurately.
* A learning and professional growth mentality so that new software tools, systems, and processes can be adopted quickly and efficiently
* Working knowledge of clinical research concepts, policies and procedures, and human safety protection regulations and laws.
* Knowledge of and experience working with a variety of local and external IRBs, scientific review and other research committees, national cooperative group sponsors, industry sponsors, federal and foundation funding organizations, etc.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively establish rapport, building collaborative relationships, and communicate complex concepts and ideas in an easy-to-understand manner.
* Ability to adapt to changing job demands and priorities, remain flexible including working flexible hours to accommodate research deadlines.
* High degree of concentration and focus in a work environment that contains distracting stimuli, competing deadlines, and work delegated by more than one individual
* Availability to work in more than one environment, travelling to various clinic sites, meetings, conferences, etc.

jobs.title: FP Movement Associate Community Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary:

We’re looking for an energetic, highly organized **Associate Community Manager** to help bring our community strategy to life across events, ambassador programming, and community activations.

This person will be a key day-to-day partner to the Associate Director of Community + Special Events, helping turn ideas into thoughtful, strategic experiences that deepen relationships with our community. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable coordinating the details behind the scenes and representing the brand on the ground IRL.

You’ll help manage community touchpoints ranging from run days and walk clubs to ambassador programming, special events, and other grassroots activations across the US and beyond.

Role Responsibilities:

**Community Programming**
-------------------------

* ### Support the planning and execution of a strategic community programming calendar, including run days, walk clubs, ambassador activations, special events, and other community experiences.
* ### Own the community programming budget, including planning, forecasting, allocation, vendor management, and tracking spend against program goals.
* ### Coordinate event logistics, vendors, supplies, timelines, and staffing support plans across Marketing/ Retail/ Social, and other cross-functional partners.
* ### Partner closely with cross-functional teams to ensure broader brand priorities, product launches, campaigns, and cultural moments are thoughtfully integrated into community programming in an authentic way.
* ### Be hands-on at events and activations, ensuring every detail of the experience feels intentional, elevated, and on-brand.
* ### Analyze participation, engagement, attendance, and other program performance data to understand what is working, where there are opportunities for growth, and how we should strategically evolve our programming.
* ### Identify opportunities to expand the reach and impact of community programming, using data, audience insights, and emerging trends to inform where and how we invest.
* ### Continuously challenge the community strategy to make programming more engaging, inclusive, relevant, and impactful.

**Ambassador Program**
----------------------

* ### Help build and evolve a robust, scalable ambassador program that strengthens relationships with key community leaders and creates meaningful brand advocacy.
* ### Support the day-to-day management of the ambassador community, including communications, activations, gifting, events, and ongoing engagement.
* ### Help develop and execute ambassador recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and retention strategies.
* ### Cultivate strong, authentic relationships with ambassadors and serve as a trusted point of contact and extension of the brand.
* ### Track and analyze ambassador participation, engagement, performance, and program deliverables to understand impact and identify opportunities for growth.
* ### Use program insights and community data to continuously refine the ambassador experience and strengthen the overall program strategy.
* ### Identify emerging community leaders, creators, and advocates who can help expand our reach and deepen our connection within priority communities.
* ### Partner with Social, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for ambassadors to authentically support larger brand initiatives, product moments, storytelling, and launches.

Role Qualifications:

* 2–4 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, partnerships, hospitality, fitness/wellness, or a related field
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
* Naturally outgoing, warm, and relationship-oriented
* Comfortable interacting with a wide range of people and building authentic relationships
* Able to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends for community events
* A genuine interest in movement, wellness, culture, and building community

### **Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Community programming runs smoothly, consistently, and thoughtfully
* Ambassadors feel connected, supported, and engaged
* Events feel authentic to the brand rather than simply promotional
* Community members increasingly recognize the brand as a place they belong
* The Associate Director has a strong operational partner who can take an idea and independently move it toward execution

This role is based in Los Angeles, CA.

The wage range for this role is $75,000 - $80,000. Wages are based on several factors including but not limited to experience, education, geographic location, etc

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

-----------

As a Business Development Account Manager, you will play a crucial role in driving our company's growth by identifying and acquiring new business opportunities. You will be responsible for developing and implementing effective sales strategies to reach and exceed sales targets. * Identify and research potential clients through various channels.

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest-growing home improvement company—providing premium **roofing, bathroom remodeling, and siding solutions** to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.

As an Outside Sales Representative, you'll run pre-set, qualified appointments, educate homeowners on our roofing, bathroom remodeling, or siding solutions and close projects in-home.

* Run pre-set, qualified appointments with homeowners—no cold calling or lead generation required.
* Conduct professional in-home design consultations, design custom showers using proprietary rendering software, provide same-day estimates, and execute a one-sit close.

* On target earnings between $150K–$320K+ annually.
* Pre-set qualified leads—focus on closing, not prospecting.

* Monthly car allowance
* Cell phone allowance & company provided iPad

* Availability to work evenings and weekends.

* Technological proficiency in using an iPad.
* Submit to a background screening.
* Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

**More About TIMEPROOFUSA**

TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.

Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity & Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.

If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.

Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction:

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview:

The Social Media & Digital Engagement Manager will lead the Bank’s enterprise social media strategy, governance, content, creator partnerships, and engagement across English and Chinese-language platforms. This strategic, hands-on leader will use owned and external channels to strengthen brand equity, customer relationships, executive visibility, and business growth.

The role will manage a social media team and collaborate with Brand Marketing, Public Relations, Media & Advertising, Business Lines, Legal, Compliance, Risk Management, and Executive Leadership. English and Mandarin Chinese bilingual proficiency is highly desirable.

Responsibilities:

**Social Media Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and execute an enterprise social media strategy across English and Chinese-language platforms, with clear channel priorities, governance, performance goals, and alignment to brand and business objectives.
* Lead key platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, WeChat, RedNote, and emerging channels, with culturally relevant and consistent content.
* Develop the social media team and manage agency and vendor partners while building audience engagement, affinity, and customer relationships.

**Brand Storytelling & Content Strategy**

* Lead content planning and editorial strategy across social channels, ensuring alignment with the Bank’s brand voice, values, and priorities.
* Develop content that highlights expertise, customer impact, community involvement, sponsorships, culture, and thought leadership.
* Build and manage a creator strategy aligned with the Bank’s brand, audiences, and business objectives to extend campaign reach, strengthen credibility, and support customer acquisition and conversion.

**Executive Visibility & Thought Leadership**

* Amplify executive perspectives, company achievements, business initiatives, community engagement, and corporate milestones to strengthen thought leadership across social platforms.

**Reputation Management**

* Monitor conversations, sentiment, reputation, risks, and opportunities across social channels.
* Develop response and escalation protocols with Corporate Communications, Legal, Compliance, and Risk Management.

**Revenue Support & Demand Generation**

* Partner with business line and media teams to align organic and paid social efforts that support awareness, consideration, customer growth, and campaign performance.

**Employee Advocacy & Social Governance**

* Establish social media policies, governance, and employee education covering brand standards, regulatory requirements, and appropriate practices.
* Partner with Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, and Public Relations to mitigate reputational and regulatory risk.

**Analytics & Performance Optimization**

* Define KPIs and monitor audience growth, engagement, sentiment, share of voice, reputation, and business performance.
* Provide executive insights and use performance trends to optimize content, channels, and engagement.

Qualifications:

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, or related field.

* 10+ years of progressive experience in social media, digital or brand marketing, corporate communications, or related disciplines, including 3+ years of people leadership.
* Demonstrated success building enterprise social strategies and executive thought leadership programs.
* Strong knowledge of social platforms, content strategy, audience engagement, analytics, and reputation management.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, analytical, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience in a highly regulated industry, preferably financial services.

**Preferred**

* Bilingual in English and Chinese (Mandarin preferred).
* Experience managing WeChat, RedNote, and multicultural marketing initiatives.
* Experience within banking, financial services, wealth management, fintech, or related industries.
* Experience with social listening and social media management platforms such as Sprinklr, Brand watch, Meltwater, Sprout Social, or similar tools.
* Experience managing agency partners and external vendors, with preference for candidates who have worked at a creator agency, talent or creator management firm, social platform, or brand-side influencer marketing program.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is USD $100,000.00/Yr. - USD $135,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

jobs.description:
**Territory Sales Representative**  
**(1099)**

Small & Medium-Sized Business Sales + Multi-Dwelling Units (Internet services)

  

About WeLink

WeLink is a next-generation wireless internet service provider using advanced millimeter wave technology, including our own custom radios, and a proprietary approach to network deployment. Our technology allows us to deliver fast, reliable, fiber-like internet while expanding into markets more quickly and cost-effectively than traditional providers.

Founded by experienced fixed-wireless professionals, WeLink is building an alternative to traditional cable and telecom providers. We are focused on providing businesses and communities with better connectivity, competitive pricing, and a customer experience they can rely on.

Position Overview

We are looking for a motivated Territory Sales Representative to help grow WeLink's small and medium-sized business customer base.

In this role, you will take ownership of assigned leads and be responsible for executing on new business opportunities, developing relationships with local businesses, and growing WeLink's presence within the market. You will spend much of your time in the field meeting business owners, managers, and decision-makers, understanding their connectivity needs, and introducing them to WeLink's business internet solutions.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building a territory, opening new accounts, and creating business where it didn't exist before. As WeLink expands its SMB division, your work will play an important role in establishing new markets and driving long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Take ownership of an assigned geographic territory and develop a strategy for growing SMB sales.
* Identify businesses and commercial areas that represent new sales opportunities.
* Build a consistent pipeline of potential new customers
* Establish WeLink's presence within new markets by developing relationships with local businesses and decision-makers.

* Meet directly with business owners, managers, and other decision-makers to understand their internet and connectivity needs.
* Introduce WeLink's business internet solutions and explain the value and benefits of switching providers.
* Conduct sales presentations, answer questions, overcome objections, and close new accounts.

* Work with sales leadership and internal teams to develop effective approaches for entering and growing new markets.

* Coordinate with internal teams to help ensure a smooth transition from sale through installation and activation.
* Maintain positive relationships with customers and represent WeLink professionally within the business community.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, referrals, or future business growth.

Qualifications & Skills

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touchpoints serving millions of people around the world.

**At April Housing, we’re building a team of bold, mission-driven professionals who are motivated by meaningful work and energized by collaboration.** Our work supports a clear purpose of expanding access to high-quality housing, and each role plays an important part in advancing that mission.

The Service Operations Specialist supports the service department by managing the service work pipeline, assisting with RFQs and quoting, and ensuring operational continuity during

high-volume periods. This role provides overflow support for service coordination and billing while helping drive recurring revenue through monitoring programs and service

offerings. The Service Operations Specialist plays a key role in maintaining workflow efficiency, accuracy, and revenue capture.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator I : Research Cancer
jobs.description:
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

Reporting to the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, or Director of Clinical Research Operations, the Clinical Research Coordinator I (CRC-I) is responsible for all aspects of clinical research activities and works in close cooperation with study physicians, inter- and intradepartmental stakeholders, and sponsors. The CRC-I provides support, coordination for FDA regulated research including data, blood and tissue collection studies that may involve industry-sponsored, government funded and/or investigator initiated clinical research trials.

The CRC-I is involved in all aspects of research clinical process including, but not limited to protocol review, preparation and administration of the informed consent, completion of study related visit forms, ensuring protocol required assessments are completed per study guidelines, processing of lab samples per IATA standards, regular communication with study sponsors and their collaborators, and data entry into study systems within study required timeframes.

The CRC I will ensure accurate completion of case report forms (CRFs), adverse event/serious adverse event (SAE) reporting, scheduled subject follow-up, and maintenance of regulatory binders. Discusses research study with potential study subjects and answers any questions (may refer questions to Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator when appropriate) while obtaining informed consent as well as assisting in scheduling follow-up visits for enrolled subjects.

Responsible for development of study flow sheets, prepare study source documentation, gather study data, and assess subject for study eligibility (inclusion/exclusion). In addition, the CRC-I will record protocol specific assessments and ensure collection and shipment of samples, complete study forms to submit to sponsors and/or appropriate agencies, collect, enters and clean data into study database while maintaining data quality. He/she will host study team meetings, attend site initiation visits (SIVs) and perform other duties as assigned. Performs other duties as assigned.

Must be knowledgeable of Good Clinical Practices, protection of human subjects in research practices, and FDA regulatory guidelines regarding clinical research.

  

**Education and Experience**

* High School Diploma with sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team.
* Attention to details.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co-workers, & physicians.

**Preferred:**

* Medical terminology required. Working knowledge of FDA, NIH and OHRP regulatory requirements and ICH GCP guidelines.
* Understanding of clinical trial methodologies and experience filing Institutional Review Board documents.
* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases.
* International Air Transport Association (IATA) Certification
* Current ACRP or SoCRA Certification.

N/A

N/A

N/A

From robot vacuums and voice assistants to banking apps, smart toys, and backyard grills, Centercode has helped shape countless products in virtually every household, and chances are good we've impacted your life already. We're always on the lookout for enthusiastic, like-minded people to join us in making everyday life better through technology.

As a **Renewal Account Manager**, you'll play a key role in protecting and growing recurring revenue from your book of mid-market accounts. Your focus will be on renewal execution, retention health, and relationship management, ensuring customer success and contract continuity year over year. This position emphasizes consistent renewal performance, operational excellence, and customer advocacy.

  

**What You'll Do as a Renewal Account Manager**

*Renewal and Retention Execution*

* Own the full renewal lifecycle for assigned mid-market accounts
* Drive proactive portfolio management to ensure high renewal rates
* Coordinate and execute 120-day renewal engagement plans to mitigate risk of churn
* Negotiate terms and timing with customer contacts and stakeholders

*Customer Relationship Management*

* Deepen relationships with key stakeholders to ensure consistent value realization and product adoption
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers on product utilization, goals, and outcomes
* Connect with Customer Success and Support internally to solve customer challenges

*Performance and Metrics*

  

* Deliver against **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)** and **Net Revenue Retention (NRR)** targets

  + Example targets: 90%-95% GRR and 102%-105% NRR annually
* Keep renewal forecasts and pipeline accurate and up to date
* Analyze churn drivers and surface insights for cross-team improvement

*Collaboration*

  

* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps to align strategy and customer outcomes
* Facilitate handoffs to senior account managers and support expansion opportunities
* Drive internal communication on risk indicators and renewal planning
* Surface customer feedback to our Product and Services teams, shaping what we build and deliver

**What You Need** **to Do the Job**

*Experience and Skills*

* 3-5 years in SaaS account management, renewals, or customer success
* Strong relationship-building skills and negotiation experience
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and renewal tracking processes
* Confidence working with mid-market customers, multiple stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Experience coordinating with procurement and legal teams to navigate renewals and approvals
* Fluency with and frequent use of modern AI tools and practices

*Mindsets and Traits*

* Customer-centric and proactive, anticipating needs before problems arise
* Organized, analytical, and metrics-driven
* Skilled at guiding timing and value conversations with clarity

**The Nitty-Gritty**

* Compensation: $90k-$100k annually (not commission-based)
* This is a full-time, hybrid position
* Candidate must live within commuting distance of HQ office (Mission Viejo, California)
* Candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 10%
* Sorry, recruiters: We're not open to working with you on this role
* We require a satisfactory background check following offer acceptance

**More About Us**

We're an innovative tech company, and we're always evolving. Our weird and wonderful work culture is unified by geeking out hard over tech: the old, the new, and the yet-to-exist. We value adaptability over perfectionism and productivity over long hours. Also, towels. They're very important to us.

**You'll Fit Right In If**

* You *love* emerging tech: using it, talking about it, tinkering with it
* You're obsessed with using AI to amplify your productivity
* You're not afraid to ask (or answer) *stupid* questions
* You're a strong communicator but your an even better listener
* You were triggered by the grammar in that last bullet
* Your coworkers speak highly of you and your work
* You know your biggest weakness, and it isn't that you're a perfectionist
* You're a builder with a track record to prove it
* You're willing to admit when you screw up (it happens to the best of us)
* You know the answer to the Ultimate Question

**The Typical Perks You'd Expect**

* Medical + FSA
* Voluntary Dental + Vision
* 3 weeks of PTO annually ✈️ (plus more the longer you're with the company)
* 401(k) matching
Other voluntary insurance: life, disability, pet, etc.* ️

**Plus a Few Pleasant Surprises**

* We pay for your phone (unlimited data!)
* We pay for your home internet (unlimited cat videos!)
* $1,000 budget to turn your at-home workspace into a temple of productivity

**POSITION:** Marketing and Communications Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Associate Director of Marketing

**Position Overview**

The Marketing and Communications Coordinator keeps Berkeley Rep’s marketing department organized and on schedule, connecting the people, vendors, and deadlines behind every production’s campaign. The Marketing and Communications Coordinator reports to the Associate Director of Marketing and manages departmental administration, including invoices, budget tracking, meetings, and shared inboxes. * Report on social media performance using each platform’s native analytics and Hootsuite, identifying what resonates with audiences.

***Other Responsibilities***

* Demonstrate a high degree of coachability and ability to integrate feedback into daily workflows and processes.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**About GondolaBio**

GondolaBio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing breakthrough therapeutics for genetic diseases. GondolaBio is an independent sister company to BridgeBio, originally carved out in 2024 after securing $300M in private financing from external investors. GondolaBio aims to leverage cutting-edge biological research to discover, create, test, and deliver transformative medicines to treat patients who suffer from genetic diseases.

**Position Overview:**

GondolaBio is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Recruitment Coordinator to join our Talent Acquisition team on a full time basis. In this role, you will serve as a critical partner to recruiters and hiring managers, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for every candidate throughout the interview process. You will be responsible for coordinating both remote and on-site interviews, managing logistics for domestic and international candidates, and maintaining data integrity within our Applicant Tracking System.

**Responsibilities**

* Schedule and coordinate remote video interviews and on-site interviews, ensuring a smooth and professional experience for all candidates
* Be present on-site during candidate interview days to oversee logistics, greet candidates, and ensure the day runs seamlessly from start to finish
* Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates during the interview process, acting as a hospitality-focused ambassador for the GondolaBio brand
* Manage all logistics for on-site candidate visits, including creating detailed interview schedules, securing conference rooms, and arranging domestic and international travel
* Collect and track candidate NDAs prior to on-site visits
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to move candidates efficiently through each stage of the interview process, including interview scheduling, feedback collection, and reference coordination
* Utilize our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to document and log all candidate activity, including updating job postings, uploading resumes, advancing interview stages, adding notes, and requesting feedback to maintain data integrity
* Proactively communicate scheduling updates and logistics details to all interview participants
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the candidate experience and team efficiency

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in a recruiting coordination, administrative, or executive support role; experience in a biotech or life sciences environment a plus
* Proficiency with an ATS strongly preferred
* Experience coordinating complex interview schedules across multiple time zones, including international candidates
* Exceptionally detail-oriented and thorough — someone who catches what others miss and takes ownership of every logistical detail
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can manage shifting priorities without losing accuracy or composure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a candidate-first mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously across a dynamic, ever-evolving organization
* Comfortable working both independently in a remote setting and on-site when candidate visits require your presence
* Familiarity with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Teams)

**No** **matter** **your role at** **GondolaBio, successful team members are**

* **Patient Champions** who put patients first, uphold strict ethical standards, and anchor decisions in clinical and scientific integrity.
* **Entrepreneurial Operators** who take ownership and drive toward practical solutions, while exercising sound judgment, respecting established processes, and aligning with teammates and leadership.
* **Truth Seekers** who are rigorous, detail-oriented, and intellectually honest—comfortable challenging assumptions, engaging with data, and updating their views based on evidence.
* **Collaborative Thinkers** who work effectively in data-driven, interdisciplinary environments; listen actively; and welcome questions, debate, and constructive challenge as essential to better decision-making.
* **Individuals Who Inspire Excellence** in themselves and those around them.
* **High-quality Executors** who deliver against goals and milestones with precision, accountability, and appropriate urgency—without compromising scientific rigor or team alignment.

**What We Offer**

* Patient Days, where we are fortunate to hear directly from individuals living with the conditions we are seeking to impact throughout the year and learn how we can improve our efforts
* A culture inspired by our values: put patients first, think independently, be radically transparent, every minute counts, and let the science speak
* An unyielding commitment to always putting patients first
* A de-centralized model that enables our program teams to focus on advancing science and helping patients. Our affiliate structure is designed to eliminate bureaucracy and put decision-making power in the hands of those closest to the science
* A place where you own the vision – both for your program and your own career path
* A collaborative, fast-paced, data-driven environment where we inspire ourselves and each other to always perform at the top of our game
* Access to learning and development resources to help you get in the best professional shape of your life
* Flexible PTO

The base pay range for this position is $70,000 to $80,000 per year. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on a number of job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

jobs.title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
BERKELEY, CA • Marketing and Communications

  

Job Type

Full-time

Description

  

**DEPARTMENT:** Marketing and Communications

**POSITION:** Marketing and Communications Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Associate Director of Marketing

**CLASIFICATION:** Annual full-time, non-exempt

**WORK SCHEDULE:** Monday-Friday, some nights and weekends required

**SALARY & BENEFITS:** $26.78 per hour; benefits eligible after 90 days

  
  

**Position Overview**

The Marketing and Communications Coordinator keeps Berkeley Rep’s marketing department organized and on schedule, connecting the people, vendors, and deadlines behind every production’s campaign. The Marketing and Communications Coordinator reports to the Associate Director of Marketing and manages departmental administration, including invoices, budget tracking, meetings, and shared inboxes. The position traffics ad materials to media vendors and partners, writes copy for media partners, and supports the printed show programs by gathering bios, headshots, credits, and scheduling Positioning and Editorial meetings.

The Marketing and Communications Coordinator also provides hands-on support for show campaigns, partnerships, and audience surveys and coordinates Berkeley Rep’s social media presence. On content, brand voice, and tone, the Marketing and Communications Coordinator works closely with, and under the guidance of, the Director of Marketing and Audience Services. This position also works closely with the Communications Manager, who provides editorial guidance and proofing, and with the annual Marketing Fellow, who contributes to social media and campaign support.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and curious early-career marketer who loves theatre. You can track a dozen deadlines without dropping one, and you follow up until every item is in. You keep a department’s details in order so your colleagues can focus on the big picture. You write clearly, you’re fluent in social media, and you can put personality into a caption. You’re comfortable working with designers, videographers, vendors, and colleagues across the organization. You want a hands-on role where you’ll learn how every part of a major regional theatre’s marketing comes together.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

***Departmental Administration***

* Process vendor invoices, ensuring timely payment, and record entries in the departmental budget tracking sheet.
* Schedule and attend department meetings, take detailed notes, and distribute notes and action items promptly.
* Check shared departmental inboxes in Outlook and Gmail daily, and make sure actionable messages are answered or forwarded to the right person.
* Traffic ad materials to media vendors and partners, tracking specs and deadlines, and write copy for media partners as needed.

***Printed Program Support***

* Solicit bios and headshots from each show’s cast, creative team, and staff, following up until every submission is in.
* Collect show credits from Production departments.
* Schedule Positioning and Editorial meetings with internal departments and external creative teams and distribute notes and action items promptly.
* Hand off collected materials to the Communications Manager, who manages program production, writing, and proofing.
* Assist the Communications Manager with proofing and gathering approvals as needed.

***Campaign and Show Support***

* Work with the Director of Marketing and Audience Services and the Community Engagement and Partnerships Manager to identify, solicit, and contract social media influencers and outside partners for each show.
* Create an external media kit for each show with the Marketing Fellow, and solicit cross-promotions from local theatre, arts, cultural, and affinity organizations.
* Work with the Communications Manager to create pre- and post-show emails for each show. This includes building the post-show survey in SurveyMonkey and distributing survey dashboards to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage in-person distribution of flyers, posters, and collateral as needed, including participation in the TBA Postcard Distribution Network.

***Social Media Coordination***

* Coordinate Berkeley Rep’s social media channels (currently Meta [Facebook, Instagram, and Threads], TikTok, and LinkedIn) in collaboration with the annual Marketing Fellow, under the guidance of the Director of Marketing and Audience Services on content, brand voice, and tone.
* Maintain the social media calendar in Asana, aligned with production schedules, campaigns, and department priorities.
* Request, brief, track, and review content assets from the Creative team, and create some video and graphic content with Creative’s guidance.
* Develop social copy with the Communications Manager.
* Get approval from the Director of Marketing and Audience Services or a designee before posting to Berkeley Rep’s main channels, then schedule and post approved content.
* Reply to comments and messages and monitor channels for questions and feedback. Escalate sensitive, negative, or time-critical issues rather than responding on Berkeley Rep’s behalf.
* Report on social media performance using each platform’s native analytics and Hootsuite, identifying what resonates with audiences.

***Other Responsibilities***

* Actively participate in workshops and training, including harassment prevention, bystander intervention, and antiracism, equity, diversity, inclusion, and access initiatives.
* Demonstrate a high degree of coachability and ability to integrate feedback into daily workflows and processes.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

Requirements

**Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in marketing, communications, administration, or social media, preferably in the arts or entertainment.
* Exceptional organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage calendars, deadlines, and many concurrent projects.
* Strong writing and proofreading skills,

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Founded in 1971, Delta is a global leader in power electronics and energy-efficient solutions, delivering advanced switching power supplies, thermal management systems, and critical infrastructure technologies.

With operations across five continents and nearly 200 global locations, Delta supports industries including data center infrastructure, industrial automation, telecom power, renewable energy, and EV charging.

Guided by our mission — *“To provide innovative, clean, and energy-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow”* — Delta combines engineering excellence with a strong commitment to sustainability and long-term value creation.

**Position Overview**

**Location: Open**

**Compensation:** $130K - $155K (commensurate on experience)

**Bonus:** Eligible

**Travel:** Up to 50%

**Work Authorization:** This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Delta Electronics is seeking a motivated and growth-oriented **Account Manager** to support strategic customer initiatives within the Verizon account environment. This role is designed as a development opportunity, partnering closely with senior leadership and an established account leader with deep Verizon customer relationships and industry expertise.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career sales professional, MBA graduate, inside sales representative, or customer-facing business professional looking to transition into enterprise account management and outside sales. The organization is open to developing high-potential talent with strong communication skills, business acumen, professionalism, and the desire to learn the telecommunications and infrastructure industry.

The ideal candidate is polished, highly driven, relationship-oriented, and eager to grow within a customer-facing commercial environment.

  
Key Responsibilities:

* Support account management activities for strategic Verizon customer initiatives and programs.
* Partner closely with senior account leadership to learn customer operations, relationship management, and sales strategy execution within the Verizon ecosystem.
* Lead project management initiatives including; customer communications, internal coordination, reporting, account updates, and follow-up activities.
* Identify opportunities to support revenue growth, customer engagement, and operational alignment.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with internal Sales, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams.
* Participate in customer meetings, business reviews, and onsite engagement activities as needed.
* Develop a strong understanding of telecommunications, infrastructure, connectivity, and customer solution environments.
* Support pipeline tracking, CRM updates, forecasting activities, and account documentation.
* Travel up to 50% to support customer engagement activities.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree required; MBA strongly preferred.
* Approximately 8+ years of professional experience within sales, business development, inside sales, account coordination, customer operations, or related commercial environments.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with polished professional presence.
* Highly motivated, coachable, and eager to learn within a fast-paced business environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable traveling up to 50% as business needs require.

  
Pay Range: USD $130,000.00 - USD $155,000.00 /Yr. Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience selling to the Telecom or Cable Operators.
* Experience supporting telecommunications, technology, infrastructure, manufacturing, or enterprise customer environments.
* Previous exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
* Exposure to telecommunications industry experience.

Benefit at Delta Electronics Americas:

Delta Electronics offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being. Employees can choose from multiple medical plan options, including employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts, along with dental and vision coverage. Delta also provides a competitive 401(k) plan with company match, life and disability insurance, and a range of voluntary benefits. Additional resources such as flexible spending accounts, mental health support, and an Employee Assistance Program are available to help employees and their families thrive both personally and professionally.

Life at Delta

EEO Statement:

*Delta Electronics Americas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Delta Electronics America is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Benefits include health coverage, wellness resources, retirement savings plan, paid time off, and other company‑sponsored programs; parental leave is provided in accordance with applicable law.*

We help make your world a safer place.

Securitas is a global company that offers the most advanced and sustainable security solutions in the industry. We are located in 47 countries and have 355,000 employees worldwide and over 150,000 clients.

Securitas plays an essential role for our clients and in society. The Account Manager position helps maintain a safe and secure environment for our clients by managing the security services and related operations provided to an assigned group of smaller accounts including client service and problem resolution, service enhancement and expansion, new business development, operational effectiveness, preparation of post orders, staffing, scheduling, supervision and training.

We are driven by a clear corporate culture and purpose, which helps us live according to our values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness. These values are at the heart of our culture, help define who we are and guide our actions.

As an Account Manager you will be performing a variety of management functions for assigned accounts; while providing lead direction to Security Supervisors on requirements, priorities of work and coordinating any necessary needs of the site. If you have experience in positions like Operations Manager, Site Supervisor or Account Manager this role is a great fit for you.

Are you interested in being part of our Team?

* Interview from the convenience of your own home
* Weekly pay
* Competitive benefits
* Flexible schedules

At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
  
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  
**Job Overview:**  
The Account Manager (AM) focuses on identifying and developing new product opportunities within the existing customer base. This role involves prospecting, presenting programs, and meeting sales quotas.
  
  
**Responsibilities/Essential Functions:**  

* The AM is expected to penetrate the current customer base and generate revenue through additional category adds – Uniforms, Workplace Supplies, Managed Restroom Services, First Aid and Direct Sales.
* The AM will also focus on securing contract renewals.
* Key responsibilities include documenting customer information, maintaining sales reports, and communicating product details to the service department.
* The AM is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with customers to drive sales and identify new opportunities.
* Drive a systematic sampling program that leads to proposal generation.
* As a direct report to the Sales Manager, this position will collaborate with the Sales and Operations teams to sell into the current customer base.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**  

* Must be customer oriented and able to communicate effectively
* Ability to provide a high quality service within a fast-paced and physically challenging environment
* Goal driven and self-motivated to include problem solving skills
* Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office applications (including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet/Intranet)

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s/Associates Degree preferred
* Prior experience in Route Sales and/or Business to Business (B2B) sales preferred

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

We seek an experienced Account Manager to join our growing Commercial Add-On team based out of our Sunnyvale office. In this role you will focus on expanding our product footprint with our existing customer base. By joining our already successful team, you will be an instrumental part of our consistent year over year revenue growth!

Your day-to-day

* This is a Hybrid role requiring you to be in the Sunnyvale office 4 days a week. Monday-Thursday.
* The Account Manager will be responsible for working with our existing customers in a consultative manner to identify additional solutions from the Proofpoint portfolio
* Drive the entire sales process from start to finish including opportunity identification, introductory meetings, product demonstration, customer Q&A, as well as negotiation and closing
* Develop, customize, and utilize effective close plans to navigate and manage the sales process
* Team up with our world class Sales Engineering team to devise and execute account strategies and plans

• Engage with our rapidly expanding channel partner network to educate, inform, and drive incremental revenue • Interact with the management team in 1-1, team meetings and via forecasting and reporting to provide critical updates, and strategic account planning

* Provide outstanding and high touch customer service, including escalation and coordination of support issues as needed
* Become a perpetual student of Proofpoint products, and the ever-changing Cybersecurity industry!
* You can achieve your quota, but quite frankly we would love you to blow it out of the water!
* May require modified work hours to cover accounts in other time zones, and occasional travel for key accounts What you bring to the team
* Minimum 3 years of solution sales experience, focused on generating net new or add-on revenue
* Must have experience selling to the C-suite, extensive experience selling to CISO, CIO, CTO preferred
* Consistent track record of meeting and/or exceeding quota goals
* Experience managing longer sales cycles (2-6 months) from prospecting stage through negotiation and closing

* Educate and advise clients of TRS-RenTelco on products and services, generating opportunities

* Strategic planning of territory activities to implement and execute TRS-RenTelco go-to-market strategy
* Perform other duties as assigned

* Organized, detailed and accurate with demonstrated high-level computer skills including MS Office tools
* Demonstrated selling and closing skills
* Knowledge of rental and lease practices
* Ability to work independently and from a home office
* Effectively communicate customer requirements to relevant departments within TRS-RenTelco
* BS degree preferred or equivalent experience
* Sales experience calling on customers, prospecting and developing/maintaining relationships for at least 3 or more years

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest-growing home improvement company—providing premium **roofing, bathroom remodeling, and siding solutions** to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.

As an Outside Sales Representative, you'll run pre-set, qualified appointments, educate homeowners on our roofing, bathroom remodeling, or siding solutions and close projects in-home.

**$4,000 SIGN-ON BONUS**

**What You'll Do**

* Run pre-set, qualified appointments with homeowners—no cold calling or lead generation required.
* Conduct professional in-home design consultations, design custom showers using proprietary rendering software, provide same-day estimates, and execute a one-sit close.
* Partner with your Sales Manager and team for ongoing coaching, joint appointments, weekly meetings, and skill development.

**What's In It for You**

* 100% commission W-2 role with uncapped earnings + monthly bonuses.
* On target earnings between $150K–$320K+ annually.
* Pre-set qualified leads—focus on closing, not prospecting.
* 4 weeks paid training at $1,000/week, plus earn full commission — not a draw.
* Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
* $4,000 Sign-On Bonus.
* Monthly car allowance
* Cell phone allowance & company provided iPad

**What It Takes To Succeed**

* Resilience and ability to handle rejection without being discouraged.
* Ability to drive 100 miles a day on average.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends.
* Comfortable working in a commission-based role.
* Technological proficiency in using an iPad.
* Submit to a background screening.
* Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

**More About TIMEPROOFUSA**

TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.

Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity & Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.

If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.

Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Global Workplace Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

The Workplace Experience team powers and connects the workday for all Perplexity employees across our global offices.

We are hospitality and experience-driven at the core. We are made up of People people, meaning that we love supporting each other and all of the People in our workplace. We take on the good and the bad with optimism and with a positive, kind approach to solving problems, dealing with the obstacles handed to us, and proactively creating good around us. We think about each moment through the lens of our colleagues (our customers) so that we can create thoughtful and memorable experiences no matter what task we have at hand.

As our Global Workplace Business Operations Lead, you will manage the business operations and cross-functional program delivery that enable our global Workplace Experience team to scale. In collaboration with the Head of Workplace Experience, you will set the operating framework for your areas, make decisions within agreed priorities and approval limits, and remain hands-on in delivering results. You will own the effectiveness of portfolio operating processes and internal project delivery.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the Workplace operating framework:** Lead annual and quarterly planning for your areas, translate team strategy into priorities and resource plans, and establish clear decision rights, delivery commitments and measures of success. Resolve sequencing and capacity trade-offs within agreed parameters and recommend when to add people, vendors or technology.
* **Lead internal capital-project delivery:** Take accountability for integrated delivery plans across office openings, refreshes and other capital initiatives. Direct the work of external PMs within agreed scopes, align internal workstreams, resolve delivery issues and hold partners accountable for schedule, cost, quality and operational readiness.
* **Own portfolio controls and insight:** Establish dependable lease administration, obligation tracking, space and occupancy information, and portfolio reporting. Set data and control standards, ensure actions have owners, and turn trends and risks into recommendations before deadlines or capacity constraints become problems.
* **Drive financial planning and performance:** Own the processes and quality of operating and capital forecasts, commitments, actuals and variance analysis in partnership with Finance. Challenge assumptions, recommend corrective actions and investment trade-offs, and give the Head of Workplace Experience a reliable basis for budget and commitment decisions.
* **Set the systems and reporting roadmap:** Own business requirements, governance and improvement priorities for workplace tools such as Envoy. Establish useful performance measures, improve data quality, and automate repeatable work while maintaining appropriate controls and keeping processes practical for the team.
* **Lead EHS program governance:** Establish a risk-based plan, clear responsibilities and a review cadence with qualified vendors and internal teams. Drive follow-through on assessed obligations and remediation across offices and remote populations, maintain evidence of completion, and escalate material risks without substituting for specialist advice.
* **Set standards for delivery and handover:** Own the development and use of project playbooks, planning processes and operational-readiness criteria. Bring together design standards and occupancy requirements, and ensure completed projects transfer to local operations with the documentation, training, vendor arrangements and issue ownership needed to run well.
* **Serve as a senior operating partner:** Lead cross-functional operating and project reviews, surface decisions with clear recommendations, and represent your areas with internal and external partners. Drive resolution within your authority, escalate material changes with options, and build accountability without adding unnecessary layers.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Senior functional leadership:** 8+ years in workplace business operations, corporate real estate, facilities programs or a closely related field, with increasing responsibility for complex, multi-site programs and their outcomes. You have operated with substantial autonomy, not only administered plans set by others.
* **Project and program management expertise:** You are a project manager at the core. You are quick and agile, but methodical when it comes to planning for, organizing, tracking, and executing on a project in a way that keeps everything and everyone aligned and on task.
* **Relevant delivery depth:** You have a record of delivering office buildouts, relocations or capital improvements as an internal owner, with accountability for scope, financial performance, schedules, change control and external delivery partners.
* **Strong financial and analytical judgment:** You have experience driving forecasting and reporting processes, challenging assumptions and translating portfolio data into resource or investment recommendations; strong spreadsheet and analytical skills.
* **Experience building an operating framework:** You have established planning, governance, performance measures and systems that helped a growing function deliver more predictably. You know when structure improves execution and when it becomes unnecessary process.
* **Leadership across organizational boundaries:** You can secure commitments, challenge constructively and resolve competing priorities across teams and vendors. You communicate risks and recommendations credibly to senior leaders and know which decisions to make independently and which to escalate.
* **Hands-on ownership and sound judgment:** You can move between portfolio-level trade-offs and project details, deliver through others without losing accountability, handle sensitive information responsibly, and maintain a kind, service-oriented approach under pressure.
